decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to quickly generate mana through artifacts like Mox Opal and Lotus Petal, while disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Hullbreacher. The key strategy revolves around using Karn, the Great Creator to tutor for key artifacts like Lion's Eye Diamond and Chalice of the Void, as well as utilizing cards like Echo of Eons and Day's Undoing to refuel your hand and maintain a strong board presence. This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast combo finish while controlling the game with disruptive elements.

This control deck aims to utilize its wide array of removal, countermagic, and card advantage to outvalue and outlast its opponents. With a focus on disruption and tempo, the deck runs a mix of efficient threats and versatile answers to control the game and grind out incremental advantages. The inclusion of Yorion as a companion allows for additional value and flexibility, while the mana base is tuned to support a diverse range of powerful spells. Overall, this deck seeks to establish and maintain control of the game until it can secure a decisive victory.

The main concept of this Dragon Stompy deck is to aggressively disrupt the opponent's game plan by locking them out of casting spells with cards like Trinisphere, Chalice of the Void, and Blood Moon. It aims to accelerate its own game plan using fast mana sources like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide to quickly establish threats such as Goblin Rabblemaster and Fury. The inclusion of powerful Dragons like Laelia, the Blade Reforged and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance provides additional win conditions, while cards like Shatterskull Smashing and Den of the Bugbear offer additional removal and reach.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn, Griselbrand, and Archon of Cruelty onto the battlefield through spells like Show and Tell and Sneak Attack. It also includes disruptive elements like Daze and Force of Will to protect the combo, along with card manipulation spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to find key pieces. The goal is to cheat out these high-impact creatures early in the game to overwhelm the opponent and win through powerful attacks or game-winning abilities.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly bring out powerful, game-winning creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Griselbrand onto the battlefield through the card Show and Tell. Utilizing various spells like Ponder, Brainstorm, and Preordain to set up the combo, the deck also includes cards like Sneak Attack and Archon of Cruelty as additional ways to cheat creatures into play. With the ability to disrupt opponent's strategies with counter spells like Force of Will and Daze, this deck aims to overwhelm and outpace the opponent with its explosive combos.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counter spells, removal, and powerful creatures. It utilizes a mix of colors to have access to a variety of tools to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes card advantage engines like Sylvan Library and Teferi, Time Raveler to stay ahead on resources. The companion, Yorion, Sky Nomad, provides additional value by allowing the player to blink permanents for extra advantage. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent with a mix of control elements and efficient threats.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, removal, and card advantage. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while establishing its own board presence. The deck includes a mix of powerful planeswalkers, efficient creatures, and versatile spells to handle a variety of threats. With the help of its companion, Yorion, Sky Nomad, the deck can generate additional value and maintain control over the game for the long haul. By efficiently managing resources and outmaneuvering opponents, this deck seeks to outlast and outsmart its competition in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

The main focus of this UWx Control deck is to control the game with counterspells, removal spells, and powerful planeswalkers like Narset and Teferi. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while drawing cards and generating value. It also has a strong late-game plan with cards like Supreme Verdict and Shark Typhoon. The deck's flexibility allows for adapting to different matchups and maintaining control of the game throughout.

The main objective of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty, then bring them back onto the battlefield using cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The deck also includes disruption and card selection spells like Thoughtseize and Unmask to protect the combo and find key pieces. The use of fast mana like Lotus Petal and Dark Ritual helps to accelerate the game plan, while Faithless Looting and Entomb provide additional ways to bin creatures into the graveyard.

The main concept of this Combo - Doomsday deck is to use efficient card draw and mana acceleration to quickly assemble the Doomsday combo and win the game. By utilizing cards like Dark Ritual, Lotus Petal, and Brainstorm, the deck aims to set up a winning pile with Doomsday and Thassa's Oracle to either draw the entire deck or win on the spot. With disruption in the form of Force of Will and Duress, the deck seeks to protect its combo and ensure a swift victory.

This Grixis Aggro deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy while deploying powerful threats quickly. The deck includes a combination of efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Snuff Out, along with disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Daze to control the game. Mishra's Bauble and Brainstorm help with card selection and drawing, while Murktide Regent and Dragon's Rage Channeler are the main threats that can quickly close out the game. The mana base is optimized to support the deck's aggressive game plan with plenty of fetch lands and dual lands.

This deck revolves around using the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo to mill an opponent's entire deck. It also utilizes cards like Goblin Welder and Goblin Engineer to control the board and find key pieces of the combo. The deck includes cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Urza's Saga to tutor for specific artifacts and disrupt opponents' strategies. Additionally, cards like Pyroblast and Red Elemental Blast provide additional control and disruption. The key strategy is to assemble the combo pieces quickly while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

This deck aims to quickly assemble the combo of Painter's Servant and Grindstone to mill the opponent's entire library in one turn. The deck utilizes artifacts and card draw to quickly find the combo pieces, with support from cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Sai, Master Thopterist. The deck also runs disruption in the form of Force of Will and Chalice of the Void to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The mana base is designed to support the artifact-heavy strategy and enable explosive plays.

The main concept of this deck is to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy while also applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets, Murktide Regent, and Dragon's Rage Channeler. By using counterspells like Daze, Spell Pierce, and Force of Will, as well as removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning, the deck aims to keep the opponent on the back foot while quickly closing out the game with efficient threats. The deck also utilizes card selection and manipulation with cards like Ponder, Brainstorm, and Mishra's Bauble to maintain consistency and tempo.

The main concept of the deck is to disrupt the opponent's mana base and game plan with cards like Blood Moon, Chalice of the Void, and Trinisphere, while also applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Goblin Rabblemaster and Legion Warboss. The deck aims to quickly close out the game with powerful Dragons like Fury and Cursed Mirror, supported by versatile lands like Den of the Bugbear and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance. The strategy focuses on creating a fast and disruptive board state to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble and cast a Doomsday combo to win the game. The deck includes various ways to generate mana quickly, protect the combo with counter spells like Force of Will, and search for key pieces like Personal Tutor and Thoughtseize. The win condition is typically using Doomsday to set up a winning pile of cards, often including Thassa's Oracle to win the game on the spot. Overall, the deck aims to be fast and efficient in executing its combo win condition.
